title: Ashbury Rewards Premier Card Expiry-Day Convention for Replacement Free Night Awards
content:
The Ashbury Rewards Premier Card moves the expiry day of a replacement. For a replacement among the Free Night Awards deposited because an award came back from a reservation the hotel relocated after its expiry date had passed, the expiry-day convention depends on the co-brand card linked to the Ashbury Rewards membership:

| Linked co-brand card | This year's elite night credits | Expiry date |
|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Premier Card | At least 50 (convention night threshold) | The last day of the month after the month reached |
| Ashbury Rewards Premier Card | Below 50 | The last day of the month reached |
| Any other case (Ashbury Rewards Card, or no card linked) | Any | The same day number as the reissue date, or the last day of the month reached when it has no such day |

**Terms.** The month reached is the calendar month that lies the replacement's total months of validity after the month of the reissue date. This year's elite night credits are the credits accrued in the current calendar year, as shown on the membership record; the linked card is the co-brand card the membership record shows.

### Dates (hypothetical reissue on 15 January with a month reached of April)

| Card and credits | Expiry date |
|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Premier Card, 50 credits | 31 May |
| Ashbury Rewards Premier Card, 49 credits | 30 April |
| Ashbury Rewards Card, 70 credits | 15 April |
| No card, 0 credits | 15 April |

For a hypothetical reissue on 31 January with a month reached of February, the last case gives the last day of February, February having no 31st.
